title: Gazpacho (Layered Tomato, Cucumber and Bread)
description: Mary Randolph's Spanish-style gazpacho from The Virginia House-Wife, one of the earliest American printings of the dish. It is a layered salad of toasted bread, tomato and cucumber soaked in a mustardy tomato dressing, closer to its Andalusian roots than today's blended soup.
notes:
GASPACHO--SPANISH

Put some soft biscuit or toasted bread in the bottom of a sallad bowl, put in a layer of sliced tomatos with the skin taken off, and one of sliced cucumbers, sprinkled with pepper, salt, and chopped onion; do this until the bowl is full; stew some tomatos quite soft, strain the juice, mix in some mustard, oil, and water, and pour over it; make it two hours before it is eaten.

Mary Randolph, *The Virginia Housewife; or, Methodical Cook* (1860 edition; first published 1824), "Poultry, &c." section, Project Gutenberg eBook #12519.

Adapted: quantities added throughout, the tomato dressing is chilled before pouring, and the bowl rests in the refrigerator rather than at room temperature.
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds (680 g) ripe tomatoes, roughly chopped
4 thick slices (about 6 oz / 170 g) day-old country bread, toasted
2 pounds (900 g) ripe tomatoes, peeled and sliced
steps: Put the chopped tomatoes in a saucepan over medium heat and stew, stirring now and then, until completely soft, 15 to 20 minutes.
Press through a sieve, discarding the skins and seeds. Cool, then whisk in the mustard, oil, water, and salt. Chill until cold.
To peel the tomatoes for layering, cut a shallow X in the base of each, drop into boiling water for 30 seconds, then into ice water, and slip off the skins.
Tear the toasted bread into large pieces and cover the bottom of a deep glass salad bowl.
Add a layer of sliced tomatoes, then a layer of cucumber. Season with some of the salt and pepper and scatter with onion. Repeat until the bowl is full.
Pour the dressing over the top. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours so the bread soaks up the juices.
Spoon into shallow bowls, making sure each serving gets bread, vegetables, and plenty of the liquid.
